summary: AAP manages three sets of secrets: local user passwords, operational secrets (database and message bus passwords) and automation secrets (SSH keys, cloud and vault credentials). Hardening advice: use a privileged access solution, keep credentials unique and stored only in AAP or a supported external secrets manager, separate automation credentials from admin logins, and use different keys per automation level.
